annotation.justification: The clause provides clear and specific requirements for TCP endpoints that do not implement PUSH flags. It mandates that they (1) must not buffer data indefinitely and (2) must set the PSH bit in the last buffered segment. These requirements are unambiguous and do not allow for multiple materially different interpretations. There is no missing constraint or undefined term that would lead to ambiguity in implementation behavior.
